tracks.title: today is my favorite
tracks.excerpt: An album-length EP by the 20-year-old producer is a dizzying and boundless collage of collages, using free-jazz logic and digital overload to chart new emotional terrain.
tracks.excerpt_zh: 这位20岁的制片人制作了一张专辑长度的EP ，这是一张令人眼花缭乱的无限拼贴画，使用自由爵士逻辑和数字过载来绘制新的情感地形。

tracks.title: School's Out!
tracks.excerpt: The irreverent duo of Leo Fincham and Rowan Please plies its brilliantly digitized indie-pop bricolage on an album with the ragtag splendor of a low-budget musical.
tracks.excerpt_zh: 不敬的Leo Fincham和Rowan Please二人组合将其精彩的数字化独立流行拼凑在一张专辑中，并伴随着低成本音乐剧的破烂辉煌。

tracks.title: Favourite T-Shirt
tracks.excerpt: Birthday girl Ella Mai celebrates turning 32 with the release of the surprise project ‘3two,’ and she is in lovergirl mode on the EP. The post Ella Mai Chooses Love On Surprise EP ‘3two’ appeared first on SoulBounce .
tracks.excerpt_zh: 寿星Ella Mai以惊喜项目“3two”的发布来庆祝自己32岁生日，在这张EP中，她处于“恋爱少女”模式。这篇文章《Ella Mai在惊喜EP《3two》中选择爱情》最初发表在SoulBounce上。

tracks.title: The thing
tracks.excerpt: The Danish artist achieves a beguiling flow state on her second solo album: a set of future standards full of empty space.
tracks.excerpt_zh: 这位丹麦艺术家在她的第二张个人专辑中实现了一种迷人的流动状态：一套充满空旷空间的未来标准。

tracks.excerpt: We all need a hobby. Some people get into fantasy football. Others are obsessed with knitting. There’s cosplay, astronomy, astrology, ham radio … the possibilities are endless. But for my money, the best hobby a guy or gal can have is Bob Dylan. The man just continues to give, even as he cruises through his mid-eighties. The post Bob Dylan :: The Rolling Thunder Revue: The 1976 Live Recordings fir
tracks.excerpt_zh: 我们都需要一个爱好。有些人迷上了梦幻足球。还有人迷上了编织。还有角色扮演、天文学、占星术、业余无线电……可能性无穷无尽。但依我看，一个男人或女人最好的爱好就是鲍勃·迪伦。这位老人不断地奉献，即使他已年过八旬。文章《鲍勃·迪伦：滚雷巡演：1976年现场录音》

tracks.title: Chelsea Bridge
tracks.excerpt: Music for Loving (1955) contains some of Ben Webster’s most sophisticated and elegant work, and the larger arrangements avoid the pitfalls of the “jazz-with-strings” genre. This is none more apparent than when the orchestral bells and whistles step aside, allowing Webster and his band the space to linger in the crestfallen ballads. This is the way the expansive electroacoustic ensemble mark the year with their most anticipated eponymous
tracks.excerpt_zh: Spydergum Spydergum这支大型即兴乐团的成员包括Concepción Huerta、Luka Aron等人，汇聚了众多元素。Spydergum的《Spydergum》它粘稠，能渗透肌肤。那种刺痛感令人痛苦地兴奋。Spydergum需要的是用心聆听。这就是这个庞大的电子声学乐团以他们最受期待的同名作品来为这一年留下印记的方式。

tracks.title: Salut!
tracks.excerpt: Yet another stunning archival find from the Freedom to Spend label?! Every time this crew pops up, you ask yourself how they’ve somehow unearthed more astounding and unique gems from the past. But FT$ has that magic touch. Case in point: Concern and Simplicity Volume 1: Original Recordings, 1981–1986 , Freedom to Spend’s latest release. Made up of barely circulated material by the late Swiss piani
tracks.excerpt_zh: Freedom to Spend厂牌又一次令人惊叹的档案发现？！每当这个团队出现时，您都会不禁想知道他们是如何从过去发掘出更多令人惊叹的独特瑰宝的。但FT$就是有这种魔力。一个典型的例子是Freedom to Spend最新发布的《Concern and Simplicity Volume 1: Original Recordings, 1981–1986》。这张专辑收录了已故瑞士钢琴家几乎未曾流传的作品。

tracks.title: This is How it Should Be Done
tracks.excerpt: For their collaborative full-length debut, Eris Drew and Octo Octa hunkered down in their New Hampshire cabin to craft a celebratory, sample-heavy tribute to the maximalist dance music of yore.
tracks.excerpt_zh: Eris Drew和Octo Octa在他们的新罕布什尔州小木屋里蹲下，为他们合作的全长首演制作了一个庆祝性的样品，向昔日的极致舞曲致敬。
